dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge displays a smooth, slight concave spline curve typical of a falcate fin silhouette.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Obtuse, rounded apex with a pixel radius of approximately 15-20 pixels at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin contour is oriented at approximately 42 degrees relative to the animal's longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Width of the fin base is approximately 1.4 times the vertical height from base to apex.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Continuous large-radius convex arc extending from the dorsal blowhole region to the lower jaw distally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible faint linear surface marks and light-colored striations on the lateral flank near the pectoral fin region.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct dark ocular ring and pointed distal termination of the visible pectoral fin.
